data.exact_reserve_text: The adverse impacts to the underwriting result were partially offset by a release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release). This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Change in the Ogden tables decreased the discount rate from 2.5% to -0.75%, adversely impacting reserves held on the 2014 and prior years of account relating to UK Motor Treaty business resulting in a strengthening to the prior year losses.
2016 year was impacted by natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires and Hurricane Matthew.

named_events.event_name: 2017 natural catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, Northern California wildfires, Nate, Southern California wildfires)
named_events.loss_description: Significantly impacted by GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses arising during the third and fourth quarters of 2017; these contributed 16.1% to the combined ratio.
Natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires impacted 2016.
Natural catastrophe losses on Hurricane Matthew impacted 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m driven by more favourable claims development and efficient claims handling, partially offset by a GBP 52.4m strengthening resulting from the Ogden discount rate change which adversely impacted reserves on 2014 and prior UK Motor treaty business. The 2017 underwriting result was also hit by GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, Northern & Southern California wildfires, Nate) which affected current year underwriting performance.
raw_causal_phrases: release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release).
more favourable claims development than originally anticipated

change to the Ogden discount rate. On February 27, 2017 the UK Ministry of Justice announced that the discount rate in the Ogden tables will decrease from 2.5% to minus 0.75%. As a result of this reduction the reserves held on the 2014 and prior years of account relating to UK Motor Treaty business have been adversely impacted, resulting in a GBP 52.4m strengthening to the prior year losses.

significantly impacted by GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses arising during the third and fourth quarters of 2017; (hurricane Harvey; hurricane Irma; hurricane Maria; Mexico City earthquake; Northern California wildfires; hurricane Nate; Southern California wildfires).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is the explicitly stated release of GBP 59.2m from the Managing Agent narrative (this appears to be a net figure). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement line was found in the technical reserves note; the gross 'movement in provision' line includes current year catastrophe movements and RITC, so it was not used. RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 and the inclusion of RITC in 2016 distorts development tables; triangle extraction is available but was not used to derive the prior year movement due to RITC and parsing ambiguity. Prior year development therefore recorded as NET of reinsurance (explicit) and flagged accordingly.

_claims_triangle.notes: Gross claims development triangle present in Technical Provisions note (pages ~34-35) but detailed row/column alignment could not be reliably parsed from the provided text due to formatting and the presence of an 'All prior years' aggregate column and RITC adjustments. Analysts should refer to the original PDF for the full triangle.
